<div class="elementor-column elementor-col-50 elementor-top-column elementor-element elementor-element-754d436" data-id="754d436" data-element_type="column" data-settings="{&quot;background_background&quot;:&quot;classic&quot;}">

<div class="elementor-widget-container">
<h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Cumbuco, Brazil</h2>				</div>
</div>
<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-b36fda0 elementor-widget__width-initial elementor-hidden-tablet elementor-hidden-mobile elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="b36fda0" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
<div class="elementor-widget-container">
<p><strong>Why Cumbuco<br></strong>Experience kiteboarding luxury in one of the world’s top spots, with steady winds, warm weather, and pure good vibes. Cumbuco, the mecca of kiteboarding, is just forty five minutes from Fortaleza’s Pinto Martins International Airport in northeastern Brazil. THE SPOT, CUMBUCO-BRAZIL With endless riding options, we’ll enjoy the ocean, explore flat water lagoons, and cruise the coastline on assisted downwinders. The town blends great food, lively nightlife, and calm, laidback evenings, offering the perfect balance for every traveler.</p>
<p><strong>Feel at home</strong><br>Casa Dias de Vento is located at only few meters from the beach and a 8- 10 minute walk from town. You will feel in paradise in this beautiful house surrounded by lush plants, a gazebo area, a waterfront terrace, and a comfortable pool area designed for pure relaxation. We offer spacious rooms with private bathrooms to ensure privacy and comfort.</p>
<p><strong>Fresh local cuisine<br></strong>Nutritious continental and local breakfasts, gourmet meals at home, and dinners in our favorite restaurants are planned so you can enjoy a full culinary experience during your vacation.</p>
<p><strong>Consistent Winds &amp; Smooth Flatwater</strong><br>Reliable trade winds, spacious ocean spot and natural lagoons create optimal conditions for Big air, tricks and progression.</p>
<p><strong>High-end coaching</strong><br>Progress quickly with our unique coaching, featuring live feedback and video analysis of your riding. Join our kite clinics for expert guidance.</p>
<p><strong>Yoga&nbsp;</strong><br>Unwind with tailored yoga, adapted for everyone to enhance your riding skills and overall well-being.</p>								</div>
</div>

<div class="elementor-widget-container">

<div class="elementor-widget-container">
<h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">First timers 
Are Welcome</h2>				</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-db89ffc elementor-widget__width-initial elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="db89ffc" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
<div class="elementor-widget-container">
<p>Cumbuco is one of the perfect place to begin your kiteboarding journey. With reliable wind every single day, you’ll have endless opportunities to practice and progress quickly. The lagoon’s flat or the shallow ocean spots at low tide provide a safe and controlled environment to build your confidence. You’ll be guided by expert instructors who tailor their coaching to your needs, using top-of-the-line gear to ensure every session is smooth and enjoyable. Whether you’re starting from scratch or looking to improve, Ilha do Guajiru offers everything you need for an unforgettable experience.</p>								</div>

<div class="elementor-widget-wrap elementor-element-populated">
<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-6dbe646 elementor-hidden-tablet elementor-hidden-mobile elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="6dbe646" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
<div class="elementor-widget-container">
<h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Expert Coaching</h2>				</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="elementor-section elementor-inner-section elementor-element elementor-element-25ef34e elementor-hidden-tablet elementor-hidden-mobile elementor-section-boxed elementor-section-height-default elementor-section-height-default" data-id="25ef34e" data-element_type="section">
<div class="elementor-container elementor-column-gap-default">
<div class="elementor-column elementor-col-100 elementor-inner-column elementor-element elementor-element-bc0af97" data-id="bc0af97" data-element_type="column">
<div class="elementor-widget-wrap">
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-0cca40a elementor-hidden-tablet elementor-hidden-mobile elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="0cca40a" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
<div class="elementor-widget-container">
<p>Our expert coaching begins with capturing video footage of each guest as they ride, giving us a clear view of their technique. We then ride alongside you, offering hands-on guidance and demonstrating key movements to ensure you fully understand the skills you&#8217;re working on. After each session, we conduct a detailed video analysis, to highlight areas for improvement. This personalized approach helps you refine your technique quickly, while our expert feedback ensures you make consistent progress every day. </p>								</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="e-con-inner">
<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-80e7fed elementor-hidden-desktop elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="80e7fed" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
<div class="elementor-widget-container">
<h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">First Timers Are Welcome</h2>				</div>
</div>
<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-0d248d4 elementor-hidden-desktop elementor-widget elementor-widget-n-accordion" data-id="0d248d4" data-element_type="widget" data-settings="{&quot;default_state&quot;:&quot;all_collapsed&quot;,&quot;max_items_expended&quot;:&quot;one&quot;,&quot;n_accordion_animation_duration&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;ms&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:400,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]}}" data-widget_type="nested-accordion.default">
<div class="elementor-widget-container">
<div class="e-n-accordion" aria-label="Accordion. Open links with Enter or Space, close with Escape, and navigate with Arrow Keys">
<details id="e-n-accordion-item-1370" class="e-n-accordion-item" >
<summary class="e-n-accordion-item-title" data-accordion-index="1" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="e-n-accordion-item-1370" >
<span class='e-n-accordion-item-title-header'><div class="e-n-accordion-item-title-text"> Read More </div></span>
<span class='e-n-accordion-item-title-icon'>
<span class='e-opened' ><i aria-hidden="true" class="fas fa-minus"></i></span>
<span class='e-closed'><i aria-hidden="true" class="fas fa-plus"></i></span>
</span>
</summary>
<div role="region" aria-labelledby="e-n-accordion-item-1370" class="elementor-element elementor-element-8716d81 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="8716d81" data-element_type="container">
<div role="region" aria-labelledby="e-n-accordion-item-1370" class="elementor-element elementor-element-d2fba2b e-flex e-con-boxed e-con e-child" data-id="d2fba2b" data-element_type="container">
<div class="e-con-inner">
<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-563b220 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="563b220" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
<div class="elementor-widget-container">
<p>Cumbuco is one of the perfect place to begin your kiteboarding journey. With reliable wind every single day, you’ll have endless opportunities to practice and progress quickly. The lagoon’s flat or the shallow ocean spots at low tide provide a safe and controlled environment to build your confidence. You’ll be guided by expert instructors who tailor their coaching to your needs, using top-of-the-line gear to ensure every session is smooth and enjoyable. Whether you’re starting from scratch or looking to improve, Ilha do Guajiru offers everything you need for an unforgettable experience.</p>								</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</details>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="elementor-widget-container">

<div class="elementor-column elementor-col-100 elementor-inner-column elementor-element elementor-element-f84aaff" data-id="f84aaff" data-element_type="column">
<div class="elementor-widget-wrap elementor-element-populated">
<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-08c9d2b elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="08c9d2b" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
<div class="elementor-widget-container">
<h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Where We Stay At</h2>				</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-d5e5144 elementor-widget__width-initial elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="d5e5144" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
<div class="elementor-widget-container">
<p>Casa Dias de Vento is located at only few meters from the beach and a 8- 10 minute walk from town. You will feel in paradise in this beautiful house surrounded by lush plants, a gazebo area, a waterfront terrace, and a comfortable pool area designed for pure relaxation. We offer spacious rooms with private bathrooms to ensure privacy and comfort. Nutritious continental and local breakfasts, gourmet meals at home, and dinners in our favorite restaurants are planned so you can enjoy a full culinary experience during your vacation.</p>								</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="elementor-widget-container">
<h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Find the best flight possible</h2>				</div>
</div>
<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-f9f2d65 e-con-full e-grid e-con e-child" data-id="f9f2d65" data-element_type="container">
<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-0e88df6 elementor-widget elementor-widget-image" data-id="0e88df6" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="image.default">
<div class="elementor-widget-container">
<a href="https://www.google.com/travel/flights?q=Flights%20to%20Fortaleza%20Oct%2023%20return%20Nov%203">
<img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="1024" height="640" src="https://www.globalkitetrips.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/original-dc6ac47e7798a87570334d6d394d86b6-1024x640.webp" class="attachment-large size-large wp-image-7765" alt="" srcset="https://www.globalkitetrips.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/original-dc6ac47e7798a87570334d6d394d86b6-1024x640.webp 1024w, https://www.globalkitetrips.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/original-dc6ac47e7798a87570334d6d394d86b6-300x187.webp 300w, https://www.globalkitetrips.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/original-dc6ac47e7798a87570334d6d394d86b6-150x94.webp 150w, https://www.globalkitetrips.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/original-dc6ac47e7798a87570334d6d394d86b6-768x480.webp 768w, https://www.globalkitetrips.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/original-dc6ac47e7798a87570334d6d394d86b6.webp 1281w" sizes="(max-width: 1024px) 100vw, 1024px" />								</a>
</div>
</div>
<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-c9fc7c4 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="c9fc7c4" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
<div class="elementor-widget-container">
<p>Search flights on Google Flights to find the best options for your kite camp dates. Compare routes, prices, and travel times across multiple airlines, and choose the itinerary that fits your schedule and budget. We recommend booking early and arriving at least one day before the camp to settle in and be ready to ride from day one.</p>								</div>

<h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Frenquently Asked Questions</h2>				</div>
</div>
<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-2ba111d elementor-hidden-desktop e-flex e-con-boxed e-con e-parent" data-id="2ba111d" data-element_type="container">
<div class="e-con-inner">
<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-b973eab elementor-widget elementor-widget-n-accordion" data-id="b973eab" data-element_type="widget" data-settings="{&quot;default_state&quot;:&quot;expanded&quot;,&quot;max_items_expended&quot;:&quot;one&quot;,&quot;n_accordion_animation_duration&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;ms&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:400,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]}}" data-widget_type="nested-accordion.default">
<div class="elementor-widget-container">
<div class="e-n-accordion" aria-label="Accordion. Open links with Enter or Space, close with Escape, and navigate with Arrow Keys">
<details id="e-n-accordion-item-1940" class="e-n-accordion-item" open>
<summary class="e-n-accordion-item-title" data-accordion-index="1" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="e-n-accordion-item-1940" >
<span class='e-n-accordion-item-title-header'><div class="e-n-accordion-item-title-text">  What if I’m a beginner or have never kiteboarded before? </div></span>
<span class='e-n-accordion-item-title-icon'>
<span class='e-opened' ><i aria-hidden="true" class="fas fa-minus"></i></span>
<span class='e-closed'><i aria-hidden="true" class="fas fa-plus"></i></span>
</span>
</summary>
<div role="region" aria-labelledby="e-n-accordion-item-1940" class="elementor-element elementor-element-2936401 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="2936401" data-element_type="container">
<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-085a4cf elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="085a4cf" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
<div class="elementor-widget-container">
<p>Our camps welcome all skill levels, including beginners. With expert coaching, supportive instructors, and a friendly atmosphere, you’ll build confidence and progress quickly on your kiteboarding journey.</p>								</div>
</div>
</div>
</details>
<details id="e-n-accordion-item-1941" class="e-n-accordion-item" >
<summary class="e-n-accordion-item-title" data-accordion-index="2" tabindex="-1" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="e-n-accordion-item-1941" >
<span class='e-n-accordion-item-title-header'><div class="e-n-accordion-item-title-text"> Why Our Kite Trips Are Worth the Investment? </div></span>
<span class='e-n-accordion-item-title-icon'>
<span class='e-opened' ><i aria-hidden="true" class="fas fa-minus"></i></span>
<span class='e-closed'><i aria-hidden="true" class="fas fa-plus"></i></span>
</span>
</summary>
<div role="region" aria-labelledby="e-n-accordion-item-1941" class="elementor-element elementor-element-84f1fb5 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="84f1fb5" data-element_type="container">
<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-4955021 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="4955021" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
<div class="elementor-widget-container">
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Kite trip prices can vary significantly among companies, and it’s essential to consider the experience and expertise of the organizers when making your choice. While some kiteboarders may excel at riding, that doesn’t guarantee they have the skills to coach effectively. An expert coach can pinpoint areas for improvement, helping you enhance your skills safely and efficiently.</span></p><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Additionally, visiting new destinations requires familiarity with the area and partnerships with high-quality local providers to ensure a smooth, enjoyable, and safe experience.</span></p><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Many camps focus on large groups, resulting in less personalized experiences. At Global Kite Trips, we prioritize smaller groups to offer high-quality coaching, tailored yoga sessions, and foster closer connections with our guests.</span></p><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Every aspect of our camps is meticulously organized. From your initial inquiry to assistance with flight bookings, special requests, and ongoing support throughout your trip.</span></p>								</div>
</div>
</div>
</details>
<details id="e-n-accordion-item-1942" class="e-n-accordion-item" >
<summary class="e-n-accordion-item-title" data-accordion-index="3" tabindex="-1" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="e-n-accordion-item-1942" >
<span class='e-n-accordion-item-title-header'><div class="e-n-accordion-item-title-text"> Why do some destinations require long flights? </div></span>
<span class='e-n-accordion-item-title-icon'>
<span class='e-opened' ><i aria-hidden="true" class="fas fa-minus"></i></span>
<span class='e-closed'><i aria-hidden="true" class="fas fa-plus"></i></span>
</span>
</summary>
<div role="region" aria-labelledby="e-n-accordion-item-1942" class="elementor-element elementor-element-350d8cc e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="350d8cc" data-element_type="container">
<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-26b2cf9 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="26b2cf9" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
<div class="elementor-widget-container">
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">While some of our destinations may involve longer flights with layovers, they lead to some of the best kite spots in the world. The time spent traveling is well worth it, as you’ll enjoy consistent, exceptional kite conditions every day. This consistency is invaluable for improving your skills and maximizing your time on the water. Additionally, these journeys offer the unique opportunity to experience different cultures, savor local cuisine, and enjoy breathtaking views, making your kiteboarding adventure all the more enriching.</span></p>								</div>
</div>
</div>
</details>
<details id="e-n-accordion-item-1943" class="e-n-accordion-item" >
<summary class="e-n-accordion-item-title" data-accordion-index="4" tabindex="-1" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="e-n-accordion-item-1943" >
<span class='e-n-accordion-item-title-header'><div class="e-n-accordion-item-title-text"> What are the benefits of booking in advance? </div></span>
<span class='e-n-accordion-item-title-icon'>
<span class='e-opened' ><i aria-hidden="true" class="fas fa-minus"></i></span>
<span class='e-closed'><i aria-hidden="true" class="fas fa-plus"></i></span>
</span>
</summary>
<div role="region" aria-labelledby="e-n-accordion-item-1943" class="elementor-element elementor-element-f8e562a e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="f8e562a" data-element_type="container">
<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-c4c0a07 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="c4c0a07" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
<div class="elementor-widget-container">
<p>We understand that committing to a kite trip several months ahead can be daunting, but there are several compelling reasons to consider booking early:<br /><br />-Early Bird Specials: By booking in advance, you can take advantage of our exclusive early bird specials, which provide significant discounts on our packages. [subscribe to our email list and receive our deals.]<br /><br />-Cost Savings on Flights: Booking your flights early can lead to substantial savings, allowing you to allocate more of your budget towards enjoying your trip.<br /><br />-Guaranteed Spot During Peak Seasons: Our camps tend to fill up quickly during peak seasons. By reserving your place early, you ensure that you have a spot at your desired location, avoiding the disappointment of fully booked sessions.<br /><br />-Room Preferences and Customization: Early bookings give us the opportunity to meet your accommodation preferences. Whether you have specific room requests or need special arrangements, booking in advance allows us to tailor your experience to your liking before the accommodations fill up.<br /><br />If you have any questions or need assistance with your booking, feel free to reach out to our team—we’re here to help!</p>								</div>
</div>
